about: The "Use with AI" instructions: local/ai-prompt.mjs (aiPrompt: Linux/macOS app, `saqme ai-prompt`) and desktop/rules.ps1
(Get-AiPrompt: the Windows app). 'dir' is the lists folder; 'file' (in ai-prompt/) is the exact text expected, compared as bytes
(LF, UTF-8, no byte order mark). 'same' cases must give that file's text with only the folder swapped: whatever the path holds
(spaces, Georgian letters, a backslash, quotes) goes in as is.

cases.about: Linux path with Georgian folder names
